en: The achievement of something you wanted; or a person or thing that does well.
ex: Hard work is the key to success.
努力是成功的關鍵。

en: Happening quickly and without warning.
ex: There was a sudden noise outside.
外面突然傳來一陣聲響。

en: To put forward an idea or plan for consideration; or to show indirectly.
ex: I suggest that we leave early.
我建議我們早點出發。

en: A set of clothes made of the same cloth; or to be convenient or right for someone; or a legal case.
ex: That color really suits you.
那個顏色真的很適合你。

en: Very good or excellent; or a person in charge of a building.
ex: We had a super time at the party.
我們在派對上玩得非常開心。

en: A meal eaten in the evening.
ex: We usually have supper at seven.
我們通常在七點吃晚餐。

en: To give something that is needed; or an amount of something that is available.
ex: The company supplies food to local schools.
公司為當地學校供應食物。

en: To think that something is probably true; or to be expected to do something.
ex: I suppose he is still at work.
我想他還在上班。

en: The white foam of waves breaking on the shore; or to ride waves on a board.
ex: We watched the surf crash on the rocks.
我們看著海浪拍擊岩石。

en: The state of continuing to live or exist, especially in a difficult situation.
ex: The survival of the species is at risk.
這個物種的生存正面臨危機。

en: To continue to live or exist after a difficult event or period.
ex: Only two people survived the accident.
只有兩人在事故中生還。

en: A warm piece of knitted clothing for the upper body.
ex: Put on a sweater; it's cold outside.
穿上毛衣吧，外面很冷。

en: To clean a floor with a brush; or to move quickly over a wide area; or a wide range of movement.
ex: She swept the kitchen floor every morning.
她每天早上都會掃廚房地板。

en: To move through water by moving the arms and legs; or the act of swimming.
ex: Can you swim?
你會游泳嗎？

en: A piece of clothing worn for swimming.
ex: Don't forget to bring your swimsuit.
別忘了帶泳衣。

en: To move backward and forward or from side to side; or a seat hanging from ropes; or a change in opinion.
ex: The children played on the swings.
孩子們在鞦韆上玩耍。

en: A device that turns something on or off; or to change from one thing to another.
ex: Please switch off the lights when you leave.
離開時請把燈關掉。

en: A sign or picture that stands for something else.
ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
鴿子是和平的象徵。

en: A set of connected parts that work together; or an organized way of doing something.
ex: The school has a new computer system.
學校有了新的電腦系統。

en: A story, especially one that is invented or exaggerated.
ex: Grandma told us a tale about a magic forest.
奶奶跟我們講了一個魔法森林的故事。

en: A piece of work that needs to be done.
ex: She was given the task of organizing the event.
她被交付籌辦活動的任務。

en: A container with a spout and handle used for making and serving tea.
ex: She poured tea from the teapot.
她從茶壺倒出茶。

en: To go to see a person or place for a short time; or a short stay.
ex: We visited my grandparents last weekend.
我們上週末去探望了祖父母。

en: A person who goes to see a place or person.
ex: The museum receives thousands of visitors every year.
博物館每年接待數千名訪客。

en: The sound produced when a person speaks or sings; or the right to give an opinion.
ex: She has a beautiful singing voice.
她有美妙的歌聲。

en: To stay in a place until something happens; or a period of time spent waiting.
ex: I waited for the bus for twenty minutes.
我等公車等了二十分鐘。

en: To move on foot at a regular speed; or a trip made on foot.
ex: We walk to school every day.
我們每天走路上學。

en: A vertical structure of brick, stone or wood that divides or encloses an area; or one of the sides of a room.
ex: A tall wall surrounds the garden.
一道高牆圍繞著花園。

en: To have a desire for something; or a lack of something needed.
ex: What do you want for dinner?
你晚餐想吃什麼？

en: Having a pleasantly high temperature; or friendly and kind.
ex: It's a warm day, so let's go outside.
今天天氣很暖和，我們到外面去吧。

en: A clear liquid that falls as rain and is used for drinking; or to pour water on plants.
ex: Drink plenty of water every day.
每天要多喝水。

en: A moving line of water on the sea; or to move your hand to greet someone; or a sudden increase.
ex: She waved at us from the window.
她從窗戶向我們揮手。

en: A road or path; or a method of doing something; or a direction.
ex: Can you show me the way to the station?
你能告訴我去車站怎麼走嗎？

en: Used by the speaker to refer to themselves and one or more other people.
ex: We are going to the park this afternoon.
我們今天下午要去公園。

en: Not strong in body or character; or not good enough or convincing.
ex: He felt weak after the long illness.
久病之後他覺得身體虛弱。

en: A period of seven days, often from Monday to Sunday.
ex: I go swimming once a week.
我一週游泳一次。

en: To greet someone in a friendly way; or something that is received with pleasure.
ex: Welcome to our home!
歡迎來到我們家！

en: In a good way; or in good health; or a deep hole in the ground from which water is taken.
ex: She sings very well.
她唱得很好。

en: Covered with water or another liquid; or rainy weather.
ex: My shoes got wet in the rain.
我的鞋子被雨淋溼了。

en: Used to ask for information; or used to express surprise.
ex: What is your name?
你叫什麼名字？
